# KaTeX 0.19.1

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.1.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.19.1

The official package SHA-512 integrity was verified before extracting only
`dist/katex.mjs` and `LICENSE`. No install scripts were executed.

Module SHA-256: `5f0c3749f8b28ce1a63b68de34d3950bb4aa1a9e0130865e4b09ecc9a250c8b7`.

This is the only bundled frontend renderer dependency. chat-agent uses native
MathML output with a fresh bounded macro environment per expression, trust:false,
and no CDN/CSS/fonts. MIT notice is shipped in LICENSE.txt and in the embedded
server assets at /vendor/katex/LICENSE.txt.
